description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceInfo plugin web interface using Google Test framework. It tests HTTP GET requests to retrieve device information such as addresses, system info, and sockets, mocking underlying dependencies.

classes.name: DeviceInfoWebTest
classes.description: Base test fixture for DeviceInfo web plugin tests, initializes plugin and web interface.

classes.name: DeviceInfoWebInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived fixture that initializes mock dependencies and sets up the environment for testing DeviceInfo plugin's web interface.

methods.name: DeviceInfoWebTest()
methods.description: Constructor, creates DeviceInfo plugin instance and queries web interface.

methods.name: SetUp()
methods.description: Verifies that web interface is initialized properly.

methods.name: TearDown()
methods.description: Verifies that web interface remains valid during test teardown.

methods.name: DeviceInfoWebInitializedTest()
methods.description: Sets up mock dependencies, assigns factories, and initializes the plugin environment.

methods.name: virtual ~DeviceInfoWebInitializedTest()
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects and restores previous environment settings.

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Tests HTTP GET request to the root device info endpoint. Verifies response structure and content format.

methods.name: httpGetAdresses
methods.description: Tests HTTP GET request to the /Addresses endpoint. Checks for correct JSON structure.

methods.name: httpGetSystem
methods.description: Tests HTTP GET request to the /System endpoint, verifying system info retrieval.

methods.name: httpGetSockets
methods.description: Tests HTTP GET request to the /Sockets endpoint, verifying sockets info.
